name: Research Continuity, Promotion Audit, and Future-Pass Guardrail Consolidation
purpose: Preserve native-validated research findings and viable alternatives, audit intended promotions versus active authority, freeze methodological guardrails, and align the next AUX and final Reactor/TP passes without new tuning or combat.

continuityScope.historicalPdsSupport: Combat Model Lab v17-v19 as registered by CP142

hardMethodGuardrails: Balance is strategic viability and differentiated choice, not equality.
No global PDS 50-percent objective or inter-family win-rate variance minimization.
Use technology-valid whole-TL ladders; quiet TLs and leapfrogging are legal.
Closed response surfaces may be reopened only after an explicit dependency invalidation.
Research evidence and provisional candidates remain separate from numerical authority until explicit promotion.
Ammunition is endurance/logistics once practical thresholds are met, not a fine per-TL tuning knob.
Final Reactor/TP tuning occurs after AUX demand closes.
